headlineOfDay: A tech-led sell-off wiped almost $1tn off US stocks as doubts over AI spending deepened, while Brent crude neared $118 on renewed Iran-US and Strait of Hormuz tensions.

markets.summary: Wall Street had a sharp sell-off, with the Nasdaq down 2.86% and the S&P 500 down 1.82%, as disappointing earnings and heavy AI capital spending unsettled investors. The FTSE 100 was flat, helped by gains in AstraZeneca and BT, while the Euro Stoxx 50 fell 1.22%. Brent rose 2.4% to $117.64 and gold fell 3.29%.

indices.label: Nasdaq
indices.note: The Nasdaq fell as concerns over AI spending and weak tech earnings hit big tech shares.

commodities.label: Brent crude
commodities.note: Brent rose as attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and fears of renewed US-Iran hostilities intensified.

losers.name: Reddit
losers.note: Reddit had its biggest one-day drop after saying search referral traffic fell significantly in the third quarter.

losers.name: Intel
losers.note: Intel had its worst day since the 1970s as its PC business is pressured by memory-chip prices and it struggles to make enough AI server chips.
